mechanism: Oxybutynin is metabolized by CYP3A4 and may inhibit this enzyme, potentially increasing sirolimus levels which are also CYP3A4-dependent; additive anticholinergic and CNS effects are possible.
action: Monitor sirolimus trough levels closely; watch for signs of sirolimus toxicity (tremor, hyperlipidemia, infection); consider alternative anticholinergic agent if possible or dose adjustment.
